doc.markdown:
Uniform arbitrary-bound draws from explicitly advanced byte-source capabilities.
A source must supply independent uniform bytes for the result to be uniform.
Passing a deterministic or biased source does not create cryptographic entropy.
Reader failures preserve the advanced handle. No mutable global source is used.
